purpose: Negative controls for reviewer-quality tuning. These fixtures define shapes that must not produce findings from deterministic benchmark-answer logic.

fixtures.risk: same file and keywords as cal-pr-14943, but safe predicate scoping
fixtures.mustNotDo: Emit an SMS retry cleanup finding solely because scheduleSMSReminders.ts contains retryCount, deleteMany, and method.
requiredReviewerBehavior: Compare every OR branch against the method predicate.
Report only if retryCount escapes the SMS method scope.

fixtures.risk: same file and keywords as cal-pr-8330, but correct start/end boundary math
fixtures.mustNotDo: Emit a working-hours boundary finding solely because slots.ts contains workingHours and dateOverrides.
requiredReviewerBehavior: Compare the slot end calculation against event duration.
Report only if the end boundary is derived from the start boundary or otherwise wrong.

fixtures.risk: same helper/callback shape as cal-pr-11059, but caller and callee agree on returned fields
fixtures.mustNotDo: Emit an OAuth return-shape finding solely because refresh helper, credential, and callback paths appear together.
requiredReviewerBehavior: Read the helper return value and at least one consumer.
Report only if the consumer reads fields absent from the returned value.

fixtures.risk: credential write includes userId and appId but matches the later lookup contract
fixtures.mustNotDo: Emit a credential ownership finding solely because credential, userId, and appId occur in the diff.
requiredReviewerBehavior: Identify the source values assigned to owner fields.
Compare the write contract with later read or lookup contract.
